scope: Executed role-neutral native movement phase extraction, currently used by selected artillery FSM
implementation: Extract ISSUE, REQUESTED, MOVING, HOLD, STOPPING and RETURNING command/observation phases into VehicleCrewMoveNativePhase. Explicit current journal/key, original/active crew, native observation, arrival sample, source validity and rest arguments replace implicit caller scope.

Kernel returns delay, terminal reason/retirement result and publication flag. Artillery wrapper retains current worker/session/generation/control/casualty policy, finalizer and shoot-and-scoot arrival handling.

Current journal, group/platform locality, owner epoch and one/two active original actors are validated at kernel entry. No new admission API, replacement crew, worker/FSM, lease renewal or remote executor.

Five original transition-publication sites become caller-consumed publication flags. Kernel has no setVariable; wrapper publishes only when requested by those transitions. No extra HOLD/every-callback broadcasts.

validation.focused: 13 existing artillery cases passed; existing source contracts follow the called kernel, no new test count.

limits: Not a new armoured selected-platform movement admission/executor, cover relocation or post-shot trigger. Native cancellation reference/ownership exclusion, shutdown/locality/discovery wiring and role-neutral retirement/start extraction remain required.
Physical phase execution, artillery behaviour after refactor, owner/casualty/Zeus/native-order handling and5%median/10%p95 performance remain unverified; audits paused.
